Details Product Description 60% mechanical keyboard STK61 60% gaming keyboard adopts a 61-key ultra-compact layout, allowing you to have a neat and orderly desktop. A keyboard without a small keyboard is the choice of most FPS gamers, leaving room for mouse movement More space If you are playing CS:GO, Call of Duty, League of Legends, World of Warcraft or any other games, the HYSSP 60% keyboard is your perfect choice! Our 60% mechanical keyboard is equipped with a mechanical Bown Swtich, a black USB-C keyboard cable, a stylish black keyboard shell and bright RGB lights! HYSSP STK61 60% mechanical keyboard is a brand new mechanical keyboard, I believe you will like it Feature: Suitable for PC/Mac/Smart phone (desktop and laptop)! Popular black and red keyboard colors! With Bluetooth mode Built-in 1000mAh can be used for about 240 hours after fully charged Bluetooth device switching mode: This keyboard supports the control and storage of 3 Bluetooth devices, and the shortcut key can be used to select among the 3 bluetooth devices that have been successfully paired. When switching devices, the keyboard backlight flashes at a certain frequency, and the backlight flashes to restore the state if the device is successfully switched Tips About Bluetooth Connecting FN+P:The keyboard will be ready to pair with devices after pressing the button (make sure the button on the keyboard is ON). Press FN+Q/W/E to pair with your three devices. When it’s completed, press FN+P again, the backlight of P key will blink until the pairing process is done. FN Functions: Fn+X: Turn on/off light effect.
